records.title: Untrusted participant injects application messages
records.attacker_prerequisite: Attacker can reach the selected DDS transport but does not hold a trusted lab identity.
records.scenario: A peer attempts to publish /chatter without an identity accepted by the intended trust domain.
records.control: Require authenticated admission, reviewed governance and restrictive signed grants.
records.verification_action: Establish authorized delivery, then repeat with an independently created authority and record handshake/rejection evidence.
records.evidence: Separate-authority delivery was not observed; explicit authentication rejection remains inconclusive. See runtime-observations.md.
records.residual_risk: A compromised trusted identity can still publish within its grants.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Listener identity gains application publishing authority
records.attacker_prerequisite: An authenticated process holds the listener identity; policy authoring or deployment could grant unnecessary writes.
records.scenario: The listener is accidentally granted publication on /chatter or a wildcard that includes it.
records.control: Generate an explicit listener read grant and default denial; inspect the deployed signed policy.
records.verification_action: Check exact generated publish/subscribe sets; attempt a forbidden application publication on the selected ROS host.
records.evidence: reports/security-handbook/runtime-evidence/results.json and named logs. See runtime-observations.md for exact scope and remaining limits.
records.residual_risk: The local check proves intended generated scope; it does not prove the runtime loaded or enforced that scope.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Missing credentials lead to unsecured startup
records.attacker_prerequisite: An operator or service starts a process with absent/unreadable enclave artifacts or an incorrect inherited configuration.
records.asset_and_boundary: Confidentiality and trusted communication; launch-to-middleware boundary.
records.scenario: A missing keystore or enclave triggers permissive fallback instead of an enforced startup failure.
records.control: Set ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE=true and ROS_SECURITY_STRATEGY=Enforce in the actual service environment; track enclave overrides.
records.verification_action: Run the missing-enclave case and record exit status and initialization errors.
records.evidence: reports/security-handbook/runtime-evidence/results.json and named logs. See runtime-observations.md for exact scope and remaining limits.
records.residual_risk: An external service manager can still supply the wrong environment; inspect its effective settings.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Local code obtains a runtime private key
records.attacker_prerequisite: Attacker gains readable filesystem/memory access through an overprivileged account, component or mount.
records.scenario: Readable key.pem is copied and used to impersonate the participant elsewhere.
records.control: Separate runtime accounts/trust scopes, restrict file access and mounts, keep authority keys off runtime hosts, define compromise recovery.
records.verification_action: Check read access as each actual account and exercise isolated credential replacement/recovery.
records.evidence: Runtime key modes were 0600 in the namespace; no host-isolation or key-theft simulation was performed.
records.residual_risk: Code in the same trusted process can use its identity; encryption of traffic does not protect a stolen key.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Authorized input exhausts resources or violates application assumptions
records.attacker_prerequisite: A participant has an allowed input path or an attacker reaches a resource-constrained interface.
records.asset_and_boundary: Availability and semantic correctness; message-to-application boundary.
records.scenario: A trusted sender delivers excessive, stale or semantically invalid inputs.
records.control: Bound queues and processing, validate data and timing, define degraded operation and recovery.
records.verification_action: Use a bounded non-actuating load/input test with resource measurements and recovery observations.
records.evidence: No runtime load or application validation tests supplied.
records.residual_risk: The toy demo does not implement a robot safety policy or independent stop control.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Provisioning or update authority introduces trusted malicious artifacts
records.attacker_prerequisite: Attacker controls an approved build input, signing role, update source or policy approval path.
records.asset_and_boundary: Software and policy integrity; supply-chain/provisioning boundary.
records.scenario: A malicious binary or overly broad policy is installed with apparently valid provenance/signatures.
records.control: Review inputs, separate update/identity/permission signing roles, record artifact/dependency inventory, constrain signing and provide recovery.
records.verification_action: Review the trust chain and exercise rejection of an unauthorized artifact plus a recovery path in an isolated environment.
records.evidence: Vendored XML inputs are hash-checked locally; no production update pipeline was assessed.
records.residual_risk: A valid signature proves a relationship to a signing key, not that the signed content is harmless.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Inspection and logs expose data or broaden operational access
records.attacker_prerequisite: An operator, compromised logger or external support tool can access logs or inspection credentials.
records.asset_and_boundary: Sensitive messages, credentials and audit evidence; administration/data-retention boundary.
records.scenario: A copied production identity or unrestricted evidence bundle discloses data or permits extra actions.
records.control: Use a separate reviewed inspection identity, scoped log access, retention rules and sanitized shared evidence.
records.verification_action: Review actual inspection grants and evidence contents; test that an inspection principal cannot issue control operations.
records.evidence: No live inspection identity or retention mechanism was tested.
records.residual_risk: Logs may be incomplete or modified on a compromised host; retain provenance and assess reliability.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.

records.title: Clock, expiry or credential replacement disrupts communication
records.attacker_prerequisite: Clock state changes, credentials expire, or a renewal/revocation rollout is incomplete.
records.asset_and_boundary: Availability and identity lifecycle; time/provisioning/runtime boundary.
records.scenario: Peers reject otherwise intended communication or retain access longer than the recovery plan assumes.
records.control: Review validity intervals, time assumptions, renewal overlap, replacement and peer/session restart behavior.
records.verification_action: Exercise expiry/renewal and removal of an identity on the chosen implementation, including existing sessions and recovery.
records.evidence: Offline example validity is illustrative; no time or revocation runtime test was performed.
records.residual_risk: Do not assume instantaneous revocation or an online revocation service across vendors.
records.deployment_risk: Unassessed: assign likelihood rationale and mission-specific impact on the target deployment.
